Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the producer method where condition.notify() is used instead of condition.notifyAll(). This means only one consumer thread will be notified when the condition becomes true, even if multiple consumer threads are waiting.
Trigger_Explanation: The test triggers the bug by calling the showBug method with 5 consumer threads. Since the producer uses condition.notify() instead of condition.notifyAll(), only one consumer thread is notified, leading to a failure in the assertion that expects all 5 consumers to process.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test run results do not provide any evidence that the bug was triggered. The test passed without any assertion errors, indicating that all consumers processed as expected. However, this does not confirm the absence of the bug since the test might not have been designed to specifically catch the race condition caused by using notify() instead of notifyAll().
